title: Q-YEAR-dependency-drift: add a loop that advances pinned versions
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `dependency-drift` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe dependency-drift
**Status:** open

A weekly pass bumps action versions, npm and pip pins and Worker compatibility dates on a branch, runs the checks and hands off a PR; a failed bump is recorded and skipped.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that proves it.
